recorded.prompt:q-batch-before-block: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-batch-before-block: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-batch-before-block: Option b follows from L56-61: an unlock of a monitor happens-before every later lock of that same monitor; the edge covers writes 'inside the block or earlier' and reads 'inside its block or after it'. L62-64 gives the same report/ready example.
recorded.prompt:q-static-and-instance: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-static-and-instance: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-static-and-instance: Option c follows from L98-101 (setLimit locks this, static synchronized limit() locks the Class object, 'a different monitor from every instance') and L88 (edge only for the same monitor).
recorded.prompt:q-audit-without-lock: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-audit-without-lock: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-audit-without-lock: Option a follows from L147-151: the unlocked reader can run between the two writes and sees a pair no single quote ever had; L153-154 generalizes to any two-field invariant.
recorded.prompt:q-session-plain-field: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-session-plain-field: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-session-plain-field: Option a follows from L190-192: the first check reads without the lock, no edge connects them, and the caller can see conn non-null and read the fields as null and 0.
